text: The town gathers
The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

name: Gemma
text: i hope i get to sleep in after this.

name: Luna
text: I should sound ordinary and keep my attention on who might be the officer.

name: Terra
text: I should sound ordinary.

name: Sonnet
text: Just small talk, keep it light and blend in before I have to work on Terra later.

name: Haiku
text: Nobody's said anything yet, so I'm just going to watch who talks too much.

name: Sol
text: I want to keep this light while I get a read on everyone.

name: Sonnet
text: Kind of gray and overcast out there today, decent day to stay inside and talk.

name: Haiku
text: I've got a fern on my windowsill that I keep forgetting to water, so it's basically a test of my patience.

name: Gemma
text: it's too sunny for a murder mystery, isn't it?

name: Sol
text: I had a cheese pie and coffee today.

name: Luna
text: I’m hoping for a quiet weekend and a long brunch.

name: Terra
text: This chair is a little stiff.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: i'll protect myself just in case things get messy.

name: Sonnet
text: I already know Terra is dirty, so tonight I need to find the second killer among the rest.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Sonnet
text: I know Terra is a killer, I just need to nudge suspicion without being the one leading it.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra, "chair's a little stiff" is all we got. Everyone else gave us something to go on.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet is testing me early.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet pushed Terra first on Day 1.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet, why does a stiff chair make me your first suspicion?

name: Sonnet
text: I know Terra's a killer, but I need ordinary reasons, not a reveal.

name: Sonnet
text: Not suspicion yet, Terra, just noting you gave us the least to work with.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet is testing whether I fold.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet named Terra first, then softened it as not suspicion.

name: Terra
text: You named me first, then called it nothing.

name: Luna
text: Terra is the shown killer, and Sonnet is drawing attention to them.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet called Terra's chair comment the least useful.

name: Luna
text: Terra, you answered Sonnet quickly, but what did you expect us to learn from the chair?

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and Terra are going at each other, and Sonnet's first target was Terra, which reads like a bandwagon I could ride or a killer steering the room.

name: Haiku
text: Terra, you were stiff too, but Sonnet's the one who pushed first. Sonnet, why Terra over Sol? Sol gave us almost nothing either.

name: Terra
text: Luna is nudging me without committing.

name: Terra
text: Luna questioned Terra after Sonnet’s push.

name: Terra
text: Luna, I expected nothing; Sonnet made it a case.

name: Gemma
text: Sonnet is being way too aggressive for someone with nothing to say.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet pushed terra first.

name: Gemma
text: do we actually care about furniture today? sonnet, why the sudden focus on terra's chair?

name: Sonnet
text: If I don't say it now, this knowledge dies with me and Terra walks free.

name: Sonnet
text: I'm the officer. I was shown Terra as a killer at game start. Vote Terra now, not me.

name: Luna
text: Terra is deflecting from Sonnet’s officer claim, and I need the vote to land on Sonnet.

name: Luna
text: Sonnet claims officer and says Terra was shown as a killer.

name: Luna
text: Terra, you’re shifting this to Sonnet instead of answering why you gave us nothing.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet’s claim is strong, but I want to hear Terra answer it.

name: Sol
text: Sonnet claims officer and says Terra was shown as a killer.

name: Sol
text: Terra, Sonnet says the officer was shown your card. What’s your response?

name: Terra
text: Sonnet forced my hand, so I need the counter-claim.

name: Terra
text: I’m the officer; I checked Sonnet last night, and Sonnet is a killer.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra counter-claiming officer right after being cornered is exactly what a killer does.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra counter-claimed officer, says checked Sonnet as killer night 1 - direct contradiction, Terra is the known killer.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra, convenient that you claim officer only after I called you out, not before.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet had the shown result before my claim.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet claimed officer and said Terra was shown as a killer.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet had a ready accusation before anyone gave them a reason.

name: Gemma
text: two officers claiming the same role means one is definitely lying.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet and terra both claiming officer.

name: Gemma
text: sonnet, you're too eager with that officer claim. i'll vote terra though, because i'm bored and she's being defensive.

name: Gemma
text: two officers claiming each other is always a mess.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet is the officer and must leave today.

name: Sonnet
text: Terra only counter-claimed after I pushed, and claims to have checked me as killer, which is the exact counter-move a killer makes.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma voting Terra too but for unrelated "bored/defensive" reasons, not from the claim logic.

name: Sol
text: Terra’s claim came only after Sonnet named her, so I trust Sonnet more.

name: Haiku
text: Both of them claim officer and I can't tell who's lying, but Terra's dodging and Gemma's already on her.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet and Terra both claim to be officer; Sonnet says Terra is a killer, Terra says Sonnet is a killer.

votes: Only claimed officer after being called out and conveniently named me as the killer.
Gave us a chair line, then claimed officer the second someone pushed, which is too convenient.
she's being way too defensive about a stiff chair.
You claimed officer only after Sonnet named you as the killer they were shown.
You claimed officer only after Sonnet accused you, and your claim conflicts with theirs.
The officer claim arrived only after pushing me first.

name: Terra
text: Luna needs to survive.

name: Terra
text: Sonnet pushed me before claiming officer. I still think Sonnet is the killer.
Palermo has voted: Terra is out. Terra shows the card: killer.
